items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So there was Freddie Green, Lonnie Simmons, Frank Clarke, Bobby Moore, who was the little trumpet player who played, "Out the Window," with Basie, remember?

ctx.x: Yeah. And he told Lonnie Simmons, the bandleader, about me, so Lonnie hires me. So there was Freddie Green, Lonnie Simmons, Frank Clarke, Bobby Moore, who was the little trumpet player who played, "Out the Window," with Basie, remember?
